description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Jackdaw Savior.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jackdaw Savior.
When Jackdaw Savior dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Jackdaw Savior trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Saffi enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Jackdaw Savior from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Jackdaw Savior enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat.
